A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  end_ms - 600000 AS recent_ms,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint,
           any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name IN ('loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb', 'loom.host.worktree_volume.free_bytes',
                          'loom.host.worktree_volume.total_bytes')
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  pts AS (
    SELECT series.host AS host, s.metric_name AS metric, s.unix_milli AS ms, s.value AS value
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name IN ('loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb', 'loom.host.worktree_volume.free_bytes',
                          'loom.host.worktree_volume.total_bytes')
      AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
      AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
  ),
  per_host AS (
    SELECT host,
           maxOrNullIf(value, metric = 'loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb' AND ms >= recent_ms) AS recent_max_gb,
           maxOrNullIf(value, metric = 'loom.host.worktree_volume.free_bytes' AND ms >= recent_ms) AS recent_max_free_bytes,
           maxOrNullIf(value, metric = 'loom.host.worktree_volume.total_bytes' AND ms >= recent_ms) AS total_bytes,
           argMaxIf(value, ms, metric = 'loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb') AS latest_gb,
           maxIf(ms, metric = 'loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb') AS latest_ms,
           minIf(ms, metric = 'loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb') AS first_ms,
           countIf(metric = 'loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb') AS n,
           simpleLinearRegressionIf(toFloat64(ms - end_ms) / 3600000, value,
                                    metric = 'loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb').1 AS gb_per_hour
    FROM pts
    WHERE host != ''
    GROUP BY host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       host,
       toFloat64(ifNull(recent_max_gb < 5, 0)
                 OR ifNull(total_bytes > 0 AND recent_max_free_bytes / total_bytes < 0.03, 0)
                 OR (latest_ms >= recent_ms AND n >= 4 AND latest_ms - first_ms >= 1800000
                     AND gb_per_hour < 0 AND latest_gb / -gb_per_hour < 1)) AS value
FROM per_host
ORDER BY host

annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}}: every worktree_root_free_gb reading in the last 10 min is below 5 GB (0 included) or below 3% of the volume, OR the slope of free GB over the last hour projects the volume full in under 1 h. The daemon halts dispatch with reason disk_full; if this host is the ETA authority every Ready ETA goes stale_inputs. Free space now or move fleet.etaAuthority. Keyed on the direct OTLP gauges loom.host.worktree_root_free_gb and loom.host.worktree_volume.{free,total}_bytes, host label host.name with a host.id fallback. A host that reports no free-space gauge is unknown, never 0 GB. Free space: `loom-daemon clean`/`loom-clean --force`, see troubleshooting.md 'Worker disk full'. Issue #10973.
